messages:
maya: Hey team, first day onboarding question. I can connect to the VPN (shows connected) but cannot SSH to bastion.redwood.internal or pull images from registry.redwood.internal:5000. Any quick checks?

ops-bot: Welcome @maya! Tagging @trent (IT) and @netops. Onboarding docs: https://internal.redwood/onboarding/vpn-access.

trent: Hi Maya  Are you on company-managed device or BYOD? Which VPN client/version?

maya: BYOD MacBook Air, macOS 13.5, client SecureGate 2.9.0 (installed via SSO).

netops: Likely split-tunnel not pushing routes/DNS. Run `netstat -rn | grep 10.` and `scutil --dns` and paste outputs. Also any local firewall?

maya: netstat shows no 10.* routes. scutil shows only my ISP DNS. Client UI has "split tunnel" toggled on by default.

trent: Try toggle "Route all traffic" temporarily and restart the client. If that fixes it we need to update the push profile.

maya: toggled, restarted -> still can't reach 10.11.x hosts. ssh times out.

netops: Hm. Can you `dig bastion.redwood.internal @10.11.0.10`? If that times out the DNS server isn't reachable (push missing) or firewall blocks.

maya: dig to 10.11.0.10 times out. Dig without server gives NXDOMAIN.

trent: I'll open ONB-4999 to add 10.11/10.12 prefixes and DNS to the SecureGate 2.9 profile. @netops can also grant a 20m firewall exception from @maya's public IP for SSH so you can bootstrap?

netops: Done. Temporary rule applied, ONB-4999 created. Try SSH again.

maya: SSH to bastion now connects! But docker pull hangs at TLS handshake. `curl -v https://registry.redwood.internal:5000/v2/` shows cert CN=registry.internal (name mismatch).

trent: That's PKI mismatch we occasionally hit during BYOD onboarding. Workaround: use registry IP `https://10.11.8.4:5000` or we'll push SAN update. I'll request short-lived cert including registry.redwood.internal.

netops: Also sometimes MTU causes TLS hangs on mac tun interfaces. If you still see hangs try `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1400` then retry.

maya: Reduced MTU and using IP works. Once the push for routes/DNS finishes I'll restart the client to confirm.

trent: Routes/DNS pushed. Restart client now.

maya: Restarted  dig returns 10.11.1.5, SSH and docker pull by name both work. Thanks all!

trent: Welcome aboard! We'll add BYOD checklist items (client version, netstat output, public IP) to the onboarding doc to speed future triage.

maya: Great, appreciate it :smile:
